## POST /api/ordex/orders/batch-purchase (composeBatchPurchase) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1orders~1batch-purchase/post)

POST /api/ordex/orders/batch-purchase (composeBatchPurchase): Compose several live asks into one transaction. Up to eight asks, one funding plan, one transaction, composed only when every seller signature and every sat flow invariant can coexist. There is no partial composition: when any ask cannot be proved the answer names every refusal and settles nothing.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: buying.

## POST /api/ordex/offers/{id}/withdraw (withdrawOffer) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1offers~1{id}~1withdraw/post)

A BIP 322 signature by the recovery key proves who may stop publishing the offer.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: offers.

---

## POST /api/ordex/offers/{id}/acceptance-plan (planOfferAcceptance) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1offers~1{id}~1acceptance-plan/post)
- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#planOfferAcceptance

POST /api/ordex/offers/{id}/acceptance-plan (planOfferAcceptance): State the exact acceptance arrangement for one live offer. Given the seller outpoint, reads every value from the node and the ord index, lays out padding, buyer asset, every preserve in sat order, the seller payment at the seller input index, and change, and refuses when the Feline is elsewhere, the root no longer holds, or expiry has passed.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: offers.

---

## POST /api/ordex/offers/{id}/preflight (preflightOfferAcceptance) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1offers~1{id}~1preflight/post)
- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#preflightOfferAcceptance

POST /api/ordex/offers/{id}/preflight (preflightOfferAcceptance): Verify a built acceptance and ask the node. Parses the complete acceptance, checks every rule in spec/offers.md including both policy signatures against the committed terms tree, then asks the node whether it would accept the bytes. The answer carries the exact bytes checked.. Evidence level: Protocol verification. Tag: offers.

---

## POST /api/ordex/safeops/plans (createSafeOpsPlan) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1safeops~1plans/post)
- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#createSafeOpsPlan

POST /api/ordex/safeops/plans (createSafeOpsPlan): Build a complete SafeOps plan. Resolves every selected outpoint against the protocol authorities, builds the deterministic output map and sat flow, and returns the full plan with its digest before any wallet opens. Unexamined inputs fail closed.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: safeops.

- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#refreshExecutionShield

POST /api/ordex/safeops/plans/{planId}/shield (refreshExecutionShield): Refresh the execution shield for a plan. Re-reads every input, protocol ownership, mempool conflicts, and fee estimates, then either confirms the plan is still fresh or invalidates the signing session and names exactly what changed.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: safeops.

## POST /api/ordex/safeops/broadcast (broadcastSafeOpsTransaction) (/paths~1api~1ordex~1safeops~1broadcast/post)
- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#broadcastSafeOpsTransaction

POST /api/ordex/safeops/broadcast (broadcastSafeOpsTransaction): Relay a fully signed transaction after an explicit user broadcast action. Verifies the signed result against its plan or manifest, runs Bitcoin Core preflight, and only then relays. The gateway never composes a signature and never broadcasts on its own initiative.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: safeops.

- Source: spec/openapi.json
- URL: /reference/api/#planSafeOpsRbf

Asset outputs, third party payments, and seller outputs are preserved; the extra fee comes only from user owned cardinal value.. Evidence level: Deterministic example. Tag: safeops.

## Refusal: ACCOUNT_INVALID (refusal:ACCOUNT_INVALID)
- Source: verifier/offline-signing.js
- URL: /reference/refusal-codes/#ACCOUNT_INVALID

The account may carry only an output descriptor string. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with ACCOUNT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

---

## Refusal: ADAPTER_VERSIONS_MISSING (refusal:ADAPTER_VERSIONS_MISSING)
- Source: verifier/swaps.js
- URL: /reference/refusal-codes/#ADAPTER_VERSIONS_MISSING

The intent must name the protocol adapter versions it relies on. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with ADAPTER_VERSIONS_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

---

- Source: verifier/counterparty-asset.js
- URL: /reference/refusal-codes/#ADDRESS_MISSING

The record must name the address that controls the outpoint. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with ADDRESS_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

## Refusal: ANCHOR_INVALID (refusal:ANCHOR_INVALID)
